item.title: Hazy sunshine and above-average warmth through the weekend
item.description: The bottom line? High pressure is in control with temperatures running 10-15 degrees above average with dry skies. Changes though are brewing as s cold front will bring valley rainfall and mountain snowfall Monday and into Tuesday.

item.title: UHP trooper crashes into stopped car on I-15 off-ramp, driver arrested for DUI
item.description: A Utah Highway Patrol trooper crashed into a stopped car on an I-15 off-ramp in Murray early Saturday morning, according to the Utah Dept. of Public Safety. The driver of the stopped car was arrested on suspicion of DUI.

item.title: New details released after fatal carbon monoxide poisoning in West Valley City
item.description: New details in the case of a carbon monoxide poisoning in West Valley City that left three people dead on Friday have been released.

item.title: 20-year-old woman killed in southern Idaho wrong-way crash
item.description: A 20-year-old woman was killed in a four-vehicle, wrong-way crash in Canyon County, Idaho, on Friday night, according to Idaho State Police.

item.title: Man arrested for child kidnapping in West Valley City
item.description: A man reported for contacting boys around the age of eight approximately 15 times has been arrested for kidnapping a child.

item.title: Crowds flock to Salt Lake City skijoring event despite record-breaking lack of snow
item.description: Crowds flocked to the streets of downtown Salt Lake City on Saturday for the third annual Winter Roundup skijoring event.

item.title: 'LOVE' finds a permanent home at the Utah Museum of Fine Arts
item.description: "LOVE," the iconic 20th-century American artwork, has officially become a permanent piece in the Utah Museum of Fine Arts collection.

item.title: Lagoon Amusement Park announces 2026 opening date
item.description: Attention Utah amusement park enthusiasts! Lagoon Amusement Park has officially announced its 2026 opening date.

item.title: St. George man convicted of first-degree murder for the killing of his wife in 2024
item.description: A St. George man has been convicted of murder for the killing of his wife in their home in Sept. 2024.

item.title: 'Those who have written the soundtrack of our lives': Kenny Loggins honored, inducted into People's Music Hall of Fame
item.description: Kenny Loggins is the newest member of the People's Music Hall of Fame, right here in Utah.
